AI Overview
For a 40-person office in Sussex, several VoIP providers offer hosted phone systems with local support. Popular options include Techvu, which provides cloud telephony across the South East, and Opus, a managed IT and telecoms provider. National providers such as BT Business and Vodafone Business also cover the area.
Key things to look for:
Number porting: Keep your existing numbers.
Local support: An engineer who can come on site.
